Liquidity As of September 30, 2026, Vistra had total available liquidity of approximately $8,923 million, including cash and cash equivalents of $2,743 million, $4,714 million of availability under its corporate revolving credit facility, and $1,466 million of availability under its commodity-linked revolving credit facility. Available capacity under the commodity-linked revolving credit facility reflects the borrowing base of $1,466 million and excludes $284 million of commitments under the facility that were not available to be drawn as of September 30, 2026. Total available liquidity at such date excluded $1,375 million of capacity under Vistra's accounts receivable financing facilities. In October and November 2026, Vistra redeemed all $1 billion of its Series A Preferred Stock, paid approximately $2.2 billion in cash as part of its acquisition of Cogentrix Energy, borrowed the full capacity under its accounts receivable financing facilities, and repaid approximately $1.7 billion of debt assumed in the acquisition of Cogentrix Energy, reducing available liquidity to approximately $5.4 billion on a pro forma basis.
